definitions.explanation: A female deer. The counterpart of {雄鹿|おじか} (male deer, stag).

examples.japanese: {雌鹿|めじか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べている→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
{雌鹿|めじか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{角|つの}→角：02158_tsuno⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}えない→生える：02392_haeru⟧。
examples.english: Female deer do not grow antlers.

examples.japanese: {雌鹿|めじか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{子鹿|こじか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{連|つ}れて→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いていた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: A doe was walking near the river with her fawn.

notes:
Composed of {雌|め} (female) and ⟦{鹿|しか}→鹿：04347_shika⟧ (deer). Also written as {牝鹿|めじか}. The ⟦{鹿|しか}→鹿：04347_shika⟧ becomes じか through rendaku (sequential voicing). Part of a common pair with ⟦{雄鹿|おじか}→雄鹿：27159_ojika⟧ (male deer, stag).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雌鹿|めじか}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{子鹿|こじか} — a doe and her fawn
- ⟦{雄鹿|おじか}→雄鹿：27159_ojika⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{雌鹿|めじか} — stag and doe

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{雄鹿|おじか}→雄鹿：27159_ojika⟧ — male deer, stag, buck
- ⟦{鹿|しか}→鹿：04347_shika⟧ — deer (general)
- {子鹿|こじか} — fawn, young deer

CULTURAL NOTE:
In classical Japanese poetry (⟦{和歌|わか}→和歌：05230_waka⟧), the ⟦{鹿|しか}→鹿：04347_shika⟧ crying in autumn is a well-known seasonal image. The male deer's call for a mate is a symbol of longing and loneliness.
